style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 6ft Colour Change Digital Pyramid Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Create a dynamic illuminated display with this 1.8 m Digital FlexiBrights® Pyramid Tree. The stylish design is enhanced by 220 colour changing LEDs, allowing you to customise your display using the included remote control. Complete with a 5 m lead cable, this versatile decoration is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making it ideal for creating an eye-catching feature in a variety of spaces. Perfect for adding a modern finishing touch to Christmas displays, this illuminated pyramid tree creates a striking focal point wherever it is placed.
